d:
Prashant kishor aur mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ke ek sath najar aane par bihar ki rajniti men charcha tej ho gaee hai.
Donon ke bich rajnitik matbhedon ke bavjud mulakat ko lekar saval uth rahe hain.
Kya rajnitik virodhiyon ka aamne-samne aana vivad ki vajah hona chahie? isi mudde par dekhie khas charcha.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
